subject: Investor metrics handoff — stage sweep and evidence orchestration
messages:
From: Danielle Moss <danielle.moss@heliosanalytics.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sourcing@heliosanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Investor request: ARR breakdown + deal stage evidence

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the call this morning. The investor team asked for a succinct appendix that shows: ARR run rate per deal, committed bookings for the quarter, and a minimal evidence pack that ties each committed deal to stage-level artifacts (contracts, PO/LOI, security approvals where relevant). They want a single zipped appendix by EOD Wednesday.

High level asks:
- CSV of deals showing ARR, ACV, stage, owner, signature/PO date (if applicable)
- One-line evidence pointer per committed deal (Doc link or attachment name)
- Short narrative (150–250 words) on any deals >$250k that shifted in the last 45 days explaining the delta

Do you need anything from our procurement side for signatures/POs? I can surface items if helpful.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — they want to finalize materials before Thursday’s investor readout.

Cheers,
Danielle
Senior Finance Partner
Helios Analytics

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Moss <danielle.moss@heliosanalytics.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Investor request: ARR breakdown + deal stage evidence

Danielle —

Got it. We can deliver a zipped appendix by EOD Wednesday. Internal plan below; please flag if Helios needs additional format constraints.

Internal asks (I’m assigning owners here):
- Ben: run the ARR/ACV per-deal export and produce the CSV (include owner, current stage, last stage change date) — due Tue 3pm PT.
- Vanessa: lead evidence collation. Pull signed contracts, PO snapshots, and security approval notes for committed deals — due Wed 11am PT.
- Vivek: help QA large deals (> $250k) and draft the short narrative on any deltas — due Wed 2pm PT.
- Me: assemble the zipped appendix, produce the 150–250 word narrative summary, and confirm HubSpot record links for the investor readout — due Wed 5pm PT.

Attachments I expect from the team: a CSV snapshot, contracts (PDFs referenced as filenames), and a one-page narrative.

Danielle, can Helios accept a Drive folder link for evidence (we’ll include file-level access notes) or do you need attachments inline?

Thanks — will follow up as items come in.

Best,
Aisha
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Investor request: ARR breakdown + deal stage evidence

Team — quick clarifying notes from evidence front:

1) Stage sweep: I’ll focus on deals currently in "Commit" or "Contracting" stage first. I found three records with ambiguous stage history (two moved from Proposal to Commit in the last 10 days but lack a timestamped handoff). Ben — add the last_stage_change_date column.

2) PO/Contract stubs: procurement still needs a signed PO for ACME-X (they provided a PO but redlined supplier details). I’ll ping procurement if you want me to loop them now.

3) Redlines & exceptions: For deals with redlined SLA changes, I’ll include a one-line note in the evidence CSV like: "SLA redline pending legal — functional acceptance confirmed."

On delivery format: Drive folder is fine. Danielle — please confirm viewers vs. editors so we don’t accidentally break versioning. I’ll export a flattened zip with filenames that map to the CSV rows (e.g., "HS-7219_contract.pdf" -> matches the deal id in the CSV).

I’ll upload a first pass (contracts + CSV) by Tue 2pm PT and then finalize Wed morning after Vivek’s narratives.

-Vanessa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, danielle.moss@heliosanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Investor request: ARR breakdown + deal stage evidence

Attached are the snapshots and a draft CSV (see attachment stubs below). I took Vanessa’s note on last_stage_change_date and added columns for: owner_email, hubspot_deal_id, signed_date (if present). Vivek — I flagged three deals >$250k where ACV moved down vs. our Feb projection; please review and add your short explanations.

Attachments (uploaded to Drive and included as stubs):
- ARR_evidence_20270621.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)
- commit_stage_snapshot.csv (csv, 18KB)
- HS-7219_contract.pdf (pdf, 560KB)

Action items recap:
- Vivek: narratives for flagged deals (> $250k) — Wed 2pm PT.
- Vanessa: final contract/PO upload + naming sanity — Wed 11am PT.
- Aisha: assemble appendix + short summary — Wed 5pm PT.

Danielle: Drive link is https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBInvestorEvidence (I set view comments only for external viewers). If Helios needs attachments inline, say the word and we’ll attach PDFs in the zip.

Thanks team — trying to keep this tight so the investor readout has clean evidence.

Best,
Ben Carter
Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
